llm_response.reason: The website exhibits the following scam characteristics: recently registered domain, full privacy protection for ownership, mismatched geographic details (Dutch branding vs US registrant), non-functioning contact page and SSL issues, absence of legitimate business contact information, aggressive and unrealistic discounts (up to -58%), suspected impersonation of a well-known retailer (Kwantum) without evidence of official linkage, and no verifiable information on privacy or legal terms. These factors collectively match typical fake online shopping scams.
